warnings.desc: DAMAGING WESTERLY WINDS averaging 60 to 70 km/h with gusts around 100 km/h are likely to continue about southern and mountain areas for the remainder of this afternoon and evening. Isolated wind gusts to 120 km/h may be possible at exposed coastal and elevated locations. DAMAGING WINDS are expected to ease below warning thresholds throughout later this evening, though winds are expected to remain fresh and gusty into Friday morning. Locations which may be affected include Geeveston and Huonville
